property_summary: For any _feeRate ≤ 5000 accepted by initialize, the contract stores feeRate exactly equal to the provided _feeRate; the mutant incorrectly caps values above 1000 so some admissible inputs produce stored feeRate != _feeRate.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to feeRate so it is capped to 1000 (10%) by taking the minimum of _feeRate and 1000, changing stored feeRate after initialize.
